acceptances.approved_by: Explicit user instruction in the repository development chat on 2026-10-16: Risk accept the cockroach cve. Scoped to the identified critical CVE only.
acceptances.rationale: Permit continued synthetic development on the pinned CockroachDB release while awaiting a compatible vendor image containing the Go TLS fix. This accepts the residual certificate-validation risk; the vulnerability remains present and is not claimed unreachable.
acceptances.conditions: Synthetic data only; trusted single-host lab; development gateways bound to loopback; CockroachDB SQL and admin ports remain internal to Compose. This is not production, bank-pilot, public-preview or real-customer-data approval. The context flag declares this operating scope; the audit does not independently verify runtime exposure or data contents.
acceptances.remediation: Replace with a compatible vendor image containing the fix, execute complete container and dependency acceptance, and retire this record. Review before expiry or any deployment, image, package-version or exposure change. Other CockroachDB CVEs and all other components remain subject to the gate.
